title: He Remembered Today
in_plain_words: The words leave little room. About 10 bars in a hundred have nothing sung; kept songs leave 12 to 28. The song runs 313 seconds over 94 bars, and 80 of those bars belong to sung sections. Fewer lines, or a verse less, would leave room for the voice to rest.

The singing is one busyness all through. The verse's lines run 8.3 syllables and the chorus's 7.8 (close to the same). Kept songs change: a wordy verse against a chorus of few, held words, or the reverse. Lines of clearly different length in verse and chorus would give the tune that change.
